context.guidance: Do not write Personal Data or Authentication Secrets to localStorage, sessionStorage, cookies or outbound headers beyond what the session strictly needs. Keep identity in an opaque session identifier held server-side, and keep only non-Personal Data preferences in the browser. Where a value must be held client-side, protect it as Rule 6(1)(a) requires.

value.fix: Stop writing the user's email to localStorage. Delete `localStorage.setItem('email', user.email)` and run `localStorage.removeItem('email')` once at startup or login to clear values already stored. Keep identity in an opaque session ID held server-side, sent as an HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict cookie. When the UI needs the email, get it from an authenticated endpoint such as GET /api/me and hold it only in memory (component state or a store), never in localStorage, sessionStorage, readable cookies or custom headers. If the email truly has to persist in the browser, keep only the minimum needed and protect it as Rule 6(1)(a) requires: encrypt it with a key that isn't stored next to it, and clear it on logout.
